title: WorkPulse performance.review_started v1
description: A manager or HR started a performance review. Identifiers and the state only — period, strengths, improvements and the rating are evaluative PII and never leave the database (`.ai/security.md`).

employee_id.description: Employee the review evaluates — the subject (UUIDv7 string). Also the Kafka message key (ADR 0012).

status.description: Review state after creation; only draft reviews accept feedback.
